New Features & Roadmap


We are dedicated to providing our members with the latest technology and innovative tools to make searching, sharing, and selling simpler and more efficient.

If you have suggestions, please explore the Request New Features page to upvote ideas or add your own if it’s not already listed.

Below, you’ll find a Roadmap of our latest and upcoming features and updates:

Milestones met:


28th January 2025 ✅​
MLS Soft Launch Date to Pioneers

12th February 2025 ✅
MLS Launch Date to WhatsApp Groups with 2,500+ estate agents & Public Release.

1st April 2025 ✅
New Feature:  Short-Term Rentals Launch

20th January 2026 ✅
New Feature: AI Property Report Agent

16th February 2026 ✅
New Feature: Public Portal Launch

Milestones to come:


1st March 2026
New Feature: New Developments 

8th April 2025
New Feature: ReQuests
